name: read_artifact_data
description:
Read the live data of an HTML artifact app: the key-value store its pages share through /api/v1/client.js, shared by every version of the artifact and everyone who opens it. Use it to see what people entered, such as poll votes, to-dos, or scores.

Name one key to read it alone, with up to 64 KiB of its value, or list keys in key order, all or under a prefix, 100 at a time by default. Each entry shows its JSON value, its version, and who wrote it and when. Change data with write_artifact_data.

key.description: Read this one key. Must not contain null bytes or line break characters.

prefix.description: List only keys that start with this, such as "todos/". Must not contain null bytes or line break characters.

pageCursor.description: The nextPageCursor of the previous page. Must not contain null bytes or line break characters.
